column1: # Public records to retrieve from an unrestricted network, for the open questions in
# Tab-separated. Columns: id, priority, url, note
#   url      one or more candidate URLs separated by " | ", tried left to right until one
#            returns something that is not a portal shell. Laserfiche and PrimeGov are portal
#            applications, so several endpoint forms are listed for those.
#   priority 1 = decides an open question outright; 2 = closes a documented gap; 3 = context.
# URL provenance: rows marked VERIFIED were retrieved successfully during the 2026-09-09
# investigation or are recorded in Reports/inventory.csv. Rows marked UNVERIFIED are
# reconstructed from search-engine indexing and were never opened — if one 404s, that is
# information, not a bug. Do not treat an UNVERIFIED url as evidence that the document exists.

column4: UNVERIFIED. Legal advertisement for "2026 Tree Canopy Assessment (RFP 18-26)". Should carry the scope summary. THE decisive question: does the 2026 work buy a FLIGHT or a desk analysis of existing data?
UNVERIFIED. Aggregator listing for the same RFP. Also confirms whether the issuing jurisdiction is actually Edmonds.
UNVERIFIED. City bids/RFP/RFQ index. Look for the RFP 18-26 packet, addenda, and any award notice.

UNVERIFIED endpoints; the viewer URL is first so its links can be harvested. The 2021 Edmonds-Snohomish County interlocal work order. ONE sentence from it carries the whole conflation conclusion and has only ever been read via our own QC ledger - citing it back to the ledger is circular. Read the full work order and its exhibits; look for ANY elevation, DSM, DTM, contour or point-cloud deliverable alongside the orthogonal imagery, and for a successor or amendment covering 2026.

UNVERIFIED. Laserfiche full-text search for "lidar" - recommended by six research channels and executed by none. This is the only Edmonds system with true full-text search across packets, contracts and voucher listings. Repeat manually for: orthophoto, EagleView, Pictometry, NV5, Quantum Spatial, aerial imagery, photogrammetric, planimetric.
VERIFIED (Reports/inventory.csv). SavATree/UVM Tree Canopy Assessment 2015-2020. Read its data-sources table for exactly how the "2017 LiDAR" and the "City of Edmonds" source credit are worded.
VERIFIED (Reports/inventory.csv). 2019 Davey Urban Forest Management Plan. The planning channel that was assigned this never ran. Search for lidar, aerial, imagery.
UNVERIFIED. A 2018-dated Urban Tree Canopy Assessment that appears in no project document and that nobody has ever opened. Source of the 30.3% benchmark the UFMP inherited.

UNVERIFIED. Snohomish County's own description of the even-year 2020/2022/2024 acquisitions. Needed as a live citation for the "aerial photos, 3-inch urban / 9-inch rural" quote currently sourced only to our QC ledger.
UNVERIFIED. The City's own GIS service list. Two questions: does a 2026_Aerial_Cached service now exist alongside 2020/2022/2024, and is there ANY lidar, DEM, DSM, hillshade or canopy-height service?

UNVERIFIED. Everett council item cost-sharing into an NV5 lidar collection under a WA DNR work order covering "Thurston, Adams, and Snohomish Counties and the Cities of Marysville and Everett". Already identified as WA_LidarGaps_C22, whose tiles were proven not to reach Edmonds - fetch to confirm the AOI wording and the cost-share mechanism.

UNVERIFIED. The only reported staff statement about lidar, and every account of it is a search-engine paraphrase. The verb tense is the whole argument: the paraphrase is prospective ("will work with lidar teams") where the September email is past tense ("we've funded").

UNVERIFIED. WA DNR Urban & Community Forestry program. Grant funding was searched by ZERO of the ten channels, and it is the best explanation for funding with no appropriation and no council action. Look for FY2024-FY2026 award lists naming Edmonds, including IRA pass-through subawards.
UNVERIFIED. WA DNR lidar portal. Cross-check the S3-derived inventory and look for any 2026 planned acquisition.
UNVERIFIED. WaTech Statewide Imagery Consortium 2026 RFP. Establishes what the 2026 regional aerial acquisition actually is and who has bought in.
UNVERIFIED. Council agenda portal. JS application - likely needs a browser. Target the June 2026 tree-code study session: minutes, packet, and the video captions.
